description: Figure 8 is a pie chart representing the breakdown of average total time cost and the portion reduced by an “efficient deployment” method, shown with 2 slices. One slice is labeled “Reduction” and is colored orange, annotated as 60.9s (69.92%), occupying roughly about two-thirds of the circle. The other slice is labeled “Efficient deployment” and is colored blue, annotated as 26.2s (30.08%), taking the remaining roughly one-third. Percentage and time-value labels are printed inside the slices, there is no separate legend, and the blue “Efficient deployment” slice is slightly exploded/offset from the pie.

The average total time cost before efficient deployment is 87.1s (26.2s + 60.9s), which is reduced by 69.92% after efficient deployment."
